about.title: About Moore Air
text: Moore Air is a family owned and operated air conditioning company in Belton, Texas, established in 2003. We provide comprehensive residential and commercial HVAC services in Bell County including Temple, Belton, Killeen and the surrounding areas.

Our highly trained, experienced and friendly technicians are committed to providing reliable service in the most cost-effective manner. Our team of service technicians are licensed, trustworthy, and possess more than 50 years of combined experience working in the HVAC industry.

We ensure our technicians are knowledgeable and trained on most major brands, as well as the latest product innovations in the HVAC industry. It's our goal to offer our customers high-quality service, energy savings, and air quality improvements for your home or business.
